name: india-payroll
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Indian payroll processing for FY 2026-27 (tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act 2025), employee salary calculations, TDS on salary under section 392, provident fund, Employees' State Insurance, employer cost, CTC breakdowns, gross-to-net, Indian payslip structure, Form No. 138 quarterly statements and Form No. 130 certificates, or any question about wages, deductions or employer obligations in India. Trigger on phrases like Indian payroll, TDS on salary, Section 192, Section 392, Form 16, Form 130, Form 24Q, Form 138, PF contribution, ESI contribution, CTC breakdown, new tax regime India, old tax regime, standard deduction, salary structure India, basic DA HRA, professional tax, gratuity, bonus India or minimum wages India. It covers the new and old regime rates, rebate, surcharge, cess, TDS deposit and statement dates, interest and penalties, the Labour Codes wages rule, overtime, wage payment dates, bonus and gratuity.
